summary: The edition has 87 complete guides and 19 screened discoveries. It completes 15 earlier pending guides and details 31 substantive release updates. Today’s research covers editable transcripts and chapters, writable MIDI handoffs, multi-view scene capture and motion transfer. Blender 5.3, released November 10, supports native Gaussian splat import and rendering. Preserve the original splat for handoff because native export is unavailable in that version. XR Blocks v0.25 documents a separate WebGPU route for interactive splat rendering. SOMA 1.0 and QtMeshEditor 3.72 document distinct editable assembly and character capture handoffs. Code grants were read in full. Models, services, creative inputs and hardware or software hosts have separate requirements. This edition is based on source review and published documentation. No discovered app was installed or run. The expanded plan covered 122 fields, 1408/1408 repository-query attempts and 37 model tasks. The repository lane recorded 1406 successful, 2 partial and 0 failed queries, with 257 bounded. The model lane recorded 0 failed tasks. Metadata from 2,887 saved repository pages included 84,375 numeric identities. The complete retained backlog spans 121,834 candidates, including pilot history and 1,070 previously screened guides still pending before this edition. Creative relevance and the complete software grant were checked before including any discovery. Unreviewed and excluded records stay in local research. Live primary research yielded 374 complete usable responses from 460 distinct URL attempts, including a non-GitHub source in each of 122 fields. 4 captures reached the size bound and 82 other sources were inaccessible or unusable. The ecosystem checks cover all 8 configured groups and record available findings and gaps. Evidence labels in this edition are 0 Recommended, 0 Ready to try, 93 Quality unverified, 13 Experimental. Repository searches returned no saved rows for Camera-reactive projection installations, Editable AI transcript chapters and audio publication, Live production accessibility and routed captions, Learned material capture and de-lighting, Learned projector compensation and exhibit color, Neural splat compositing and editor interchange. Primary web research for these fields is included in the coverage notes. Updated evidence labels for previous entries: See2Sound Backend (Quality unverified to Experimental), Cypher DJ (Quality unverified to Experimental), SOMA (Experimental to Quality unverified), OpenGPEX (Quality unverified to Experimental), AtlasForge (Quality unverified to Experimental), OpenFill (Quality unverified to Experimental). 33 model tasks reached the configured response limit of 50 rows. A model record remains a discovery lead until code and use are verified. Model tasks with no rows: text2text-generation, zero-shot-audio-classification, audio-segmentation, image-matting. The separate watchlist made 66 unsuccessful repository checks. Collection logged 5 enrichment failures. Credential-shaped material in unsealed captures was removed before sealing. The affected source origins and before-and-after hashes remain in private evidence.
